**The [[National Emergency Management Agency (Nigeria)|National Emergency Management Agency]] reports that at least 52 people have been killed and over 2,000 others have been displaced from their homes in recent days in [[tit for tat]] attacks by rival herders over control of [[arable land]] in [[Plateau State]], [[Nigeria]]. '''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]], [[List of executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump|Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[Donald Trump's Liberation Day speech|Executive Order 14257]]
***The [[Nikkei 225]], [[SSE Composite Index]], and [[Hang Seng Index]] experience substantial losses following Friday’s losses on the [[New York Stock Exchange]] as a result of [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[tariff]]s. [[Economy of Europe|European markets]] also decline, particularly in [[bank]]ing and [[arms industry|defense sectors]]. The [[ASX 200]] in [[Australia]] and the [[Kospi]] in [[South Korea]] also closes lower. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c934qzd094wo (BBC News)]
***[[European Commission]] [[President of the European Commission|president]] [[Ursula von der Leyen]] offers to negotiate with Trump to avoid a [[trade war]] and further economic panic, including a zero-for-zero tariff deal on all [[Industrial engineering|industrial goods]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/eu-offers-trump-removal-of-all-tariffs/ (Politico)] [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2025/04/07/von-der-leyen-offers-trump-zero-for-zero-tariffs-deal-on-all-industrial-goods (Euronews)]
***[[President of Taiwan|Taiwanese president]] [[Lai Ching-te]] states that he does not intend to implement retaliatory tariffs against the United States. He instead expressed [[Taiwan]]'s intent to import more [[Foreign trade of the United States|American exports]] and increase its investments in the [[Economy of the United States|U.S. economy]], beginning with a proposal for a Taiwan–U.S. bilateral zero-tariff deal. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/live-blog/trump-netanyahu-tariffs-live-updates-rcna199871/rcrd76472?canonicalCard=true (NBC News)]
***President Trump announces plans to [[China–United States trade war| impose]] a 50% tariff on [[China]], escalating to a total of 104% if China does not revoke its 34% reciprocal tariff on all American goods within a day. China rejects the [[ultimatum]], maintains its reciprocal tariffs, and states its intention to match any further escalation. [https://www.cnbc.com/2025/04/07/trump-tariffs-live-updates-stock-market-crypto.html (CNBC)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/live-blog/trump-netanyahu-tariffs-live-updates-rcna199871#rcrd76516 (NBC News)] [https://www.barrons.com/news/china-will-not-bow-to-fresh-trump-tariff-threat-embassy-says-f8a373f6 (AFP via ''Barron's'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/china-criticises-trump-tariff-blackmail-market-turmoil-settles-2025-04-08/ (Reuters)]
